about.title: Where learning, law and upbringing meet
about.p1: I am In'omjon Qo'chqorov, an educator and legal scholar. My work centres on education and upbringing, legal culture and questions of public administration.
about.p2: I earned my bachelor's degree in “Fundamentals of National Idea, Spirituality and Law” at Mirzo Ulugbek National University of Uzbekistan, and my master's degree in “Public Administration Law” at Tashkent State University of Law.

items.d: Modern teaching methods, working with pupils and students, approaches to upbringing.
Raising legal awareness and explaining legal knowledge simply and clearly.
Legal regulation of how public bodies and public administration operate.
National values, moral and spiritual education, and work with young people.
